text:
Situation: Ceftazidime inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 12 to 30.7 days of supply as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds the lowest coverage at 12 days for the 2 g/10 mL vial.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists ceftazidime as "To Be Discontinued" with no effective date provided.

Our position: Current stock is insufficient to sustain operations if discontinuation proceeds. One ranked supply option exists.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchasing ceftazidime from Sagent Pharmaceuticals, which is not on FDA's shortage list today; buyer must approve the purchase.
2. Buyer to request plant location details from Sagent Pharmaceuticals to assess supply reliability; buyer must approve the inquiry.
3. Pharmacy director to review allocation protocols across Corvale East, General, and Lakeside to prioritize the 12-day supply at Lakeside; pharmacy director must approve the plan.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
